summary: The restriction is a scalar times the branching matrix applied to φ(D.borderU g); the branching matrix turns d into a scalar, whose p-adic size matches the scalar of D.restrictToY, and integral matrices do not increase p-adic norms.

steps.claim: For each g, bound the gauge of D.restrictToY(φ) at g by that of φ at D.borderU(g)·d (≤ c by h), through an equality of norms and the norm bound of an integral matrix:
steps.lean:
fun g ↦
  ((one_mul _).trans_le (h (D.borderU g))).trans' (Eq.trans_le (by
  erw [mulVec_mulVec, D.branching.2.1 _ _ fun τ ↦ (d.1.map (adeleExtension (weightEmbedding ιₚ
    τ))).det⁻¹, smul_mulVec, ← mulVec_mulVec, Units.smul_def, norm_smul, weylGauge_smul]
  use congr($(?_) * ‖_ *ᵥ $(funext (by simp [mulVec_eq_sum]))‖)
  simpa [hs, apply_ite, @starRingEnd_apply D.E, branchExp] using congr(∏ τ :
    D.Φ, $((isEquiv_placeOfEmb
    (weightEmbedding ιₚ τ)).eq_iff (s := ite _ D.N 1) |>.2 (by split <;> simp_all
    [inducedPlace, placeOfEmb_comp_star, ← v_algebraMap_eq_valuation, v_algebraMap_eq_intValuation,
    intValuation_pi, D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.3, piPlaces])).1⁻¹ ^ D.branchExp τ)
  simp [← map_inv, ← ext_iff, borderU, PolyRep.blockScalar, hs _ ▸ map_inv ..])
    (norm_mulVec_le (by simp [IsUltrametricDist.norm_intCast_le_one]) _))

steps.claim: The branching matrix intertwines the action of d with the scalar det(d)^{−D.branchExp} (D.branching), so the value of the restriction at g is a scalar times the branching matrix applied to the Weyl translate of φ(D.borderU g) by d.
steps.lean:
erw [mulVec_mulVec, D.branching.2.1 _ _ fun τ ↦ (d.1.map (adeleExtension (weightEmbedding ιₚ
    τ))).det⁻¹, smul_mulVec, ← mulVec_mulVec, Units.smul_def, norm_smul, weylGauge_smul]

steps.claim: It remains that the two scalars have the same p-adic size.

At each τ, |ι(τ(π̄))| is |N| if the conjugate of the induced place of τ divides π and 1 otherwise (isEquiv_placeOfEmb), which matches the entry of d at τ (hs); raise to D.branchExp(τ) and take the product.
steps.lean:
simpa [hs, apply_ite, @starRingEnd_apply D.E, branchExp] using congr(∏ τ :
    D.Φ, $((isEquiv_placeOfEmb
    (weightEmbedding ιₚ τ)).eq_iff (s := ite _ D.N 1) |>.2 (by split <;> simp_all
    [inducedPlace, placeOfEmb_comp_star, ← v_algebraMap_eq_valuation, v_algebraMap_eq_intValuation,
    intValuation_pi, D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.3, piPlaces])).1⁻¹ ^ D.branchExp τ)
simp [← map_inv, ← ext_iff, borderU, PolyRep.blockScalar, hs _ ▸ map_inv ..])

steps.claim: The branching matrix has integer entries, so it does not increase p-adic norms (norm_mulVec_le).
